title: Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.32465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. translated_title: 锐度感知正交化动量算法
translated_abstract: 在基础优化器的每次迭代中加入对抗性锐度惩罚，即所谓的锐度感知最小化（SAM），是一种公认的用于提升深度学习泛化能力的技术。近来，Muon 已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）的主导性优化算法，它针对重尾梯度更新——LLM 训练中的常见现象——实现了更低的样本复杂度。然而，将锐度惩罚与 Muon 更新相结合的研究在文献中仍基本处于空白。此外，SAM 在重尾噪声下的行为在理论和实证层面都尚不清楚。造成这一空白的一个潜在原因在于，SAM 每次迭代都需要为惩罚扰动额外计算梯度，对于大语言模型而言，这一开销变得难以承受。本文提出了锐度感知正交化动量算法（SOMA），将一种计算高效且有理论依据的扰动方案与 Muon 算法相结合。
tldr: 提出锐度感知正交化动量算法（SOMA），将计算高效且有理论依据的锐度扰动方案与 Muon 优化器结合，以提升大语言模型训练的泛化能力并降低额外梯度计算开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes SOMA (Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm), which combines a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded sharpness perturbation scheme with the Muon optimizer to improve generalization in LLM training while avoiding prohibitive extra gradient computation costs.
